outcome: Start work: open a fixed asset schedule with its proof file, and start a cash forecast from its scenario, as-of date, months and audience (contract mock only)
acceptance_criteria: **Fixed-asset drawer from data.** As `finance_lead`, "Fixed asset schedule" shows Proof (the file box), "Prior schedule (optional)" and "Accounting note (optional)", in that order, with the button "Start schedule". Every word comes from the E-LINES fixture; no board string is in `src`. — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/start-work-ppe-forecast.test.tsx`; `grep -rn "ppe_register_oct\|PPE-0005\|Base case · v4\|All 3 accepted" frontend/src` returns nothing; drawer at 1440 and 390.

**Forecast drawer from data, no file.** "Cash forecast" shows Scenario, As of, Months, Audience (Internal / Management / Group) and Sources "All 3 accepted", with the button "Start forecast". It has no Proof box, no file input and no "Choose a file". The Sources text is the fixture's `value`; changing the fixture changes the page. — verify: component test (`input[type=file]` count 0; Sources follows a changed fixture); drawer at 1440 and 390.

**Nothing computed or defaulted in the browser.** No audience is preselected; Months and As of are empty until typed; the page never counts sources, never reads "accepted" itself, never checks a month range or date, and renders no value the line did not send. Start stays off until the four required fields are filled. — verify: component test (initial values empty; Start disabled); `git diff -U0 frontend/src | grep -nE "months *[<>]|new Date\(|accepted"` returns nothing.

**Only Finance gets the lines.** `finance_lead` is offered both lines; `pm`, `ceo` and `none` are offered neither, and `/me` `startable_lines` equals E-LINES keys for every persona. — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/start-work-ppe-forecast-mock.test.ts tests/start-work-mock.test.ts`.

**Uploaded only when the backend says so.** Choosing `ppe_register_oct.xlsx` (98,304 bytes) sends one POST `/api/v1/cases/C-FIN-PPE/evidence` with CSRF and `{kind: "ppe_register", filename, content_base64, case_revision: 4}` (validates against the generated request schema, no extra keys). The card reads "Uploading…" until the answer, then "Uploaded · 96 KB". An answer without `evidence_id` reads "Not uploaded" and the start sends no proof. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch`; e2e request log.

**Proof is required; revision chains.** With no file, Start is off and a start sent by other means answers 422 "Proof is required." under the Proof box. Two uploads in a row send revisions 4 then 5; the start sends revision 6 and the second id. Removing the "×" card stops it being sent, sends no request, and the drawer never says "deleted". — verify: component test; `tests/start-work-ppe-forecast-mock.test.ts`; `grep -rn "deleted" frontend/src/features/start-work` returns nothing.

**Start is held while proof is unsure.** While an upload runs and while a card reads "Not uploaded", Start is disabled and sends nothing; removing the card or a successful Try again enables it (the file is required, so removing leaves it off). — verify: component test with a deferred upload.

**Wrong record.** A start carrying an evidence id from another case or persona, or one never issued, answers 422 "That proof isn't on this record. Add it again." under Proof. As `finance_lead`, an upload to `C-0101` or `C-FIN-LEDGER` with kind `ppe_register` answers 404, shown as "You can't add proof to this item.". — verify: `tests/start-work-ppe-forecast-mock.test.ts`.

**Each start lands on its work item.** The fixed-asset drawer filled as in the Boards table sends exactly one E-WORK-START and lands on `/work/W-3901`; the forecast drawer sends exactly one and lands on `/work/W-4001`. A double press sends one (idempotency key from drawer open, uploads make none). — verify: component tests; e2e request log.

**Forecast sends the typed values only.** The forecast body has `scenario`, `as_of`, `months` (an integer), `audience`, no `sources`, no evidence and no field not filled. The 422 messages "Months must be between 1 and 12.", "As of must be a date." and "Choose one of the listed audiences." show word for word under their own field and keep every typed value. — verify: component test with a recording `fetch`; mock test.

**A held run does not hold the form.** With `psl_mock_start_work=start_hold`, a forecast start returns 201 and lands on `/work/W-4006`, whose page shows "SETUP NEEDED" and no preparer or reviewer name. The drawer shows no rule, no setup link, and never says the forecast was prepared. — verify: e2e (land on W-4006, text present, no Decide panel).

**Uncertain and stale.** With `start_uncertain` the drawer shows "Check again" and "If it started, it will appear in My work.", never "started"; Check again sends the identical body and key and the mock records one start (both lines). With `upload_uncertain` on the fixed-asset drawer the card says "Not uploaded", Try again re-reads, and the start sends only the second id and its revision. A stale 409 on the start or upload re-reads E-LINES, keeps typed values and cards, and sends the re-read revision with a new key. — verify: component and e2e tests; mock test.

**Access.** Without CSRF an upload or start answers 403 and shows the refusal; 401 shows the signed-out state with `next` set to the current page; 403 and 404 on the start read "You can't start this here."; 403 and 404 on upload read alike. A fixed line without `case_revision` stays "can't start here yet" and sends nothing. — verify: component tests with a recording `fetch`; mock tests.

**Plain text, no limits, no authority from roles.** A file named `.xlsx` and a 422 containing `bold` render as literal text; no `` takes an `href` from an upload or E-LINES value; the file input has no `accept`; the diff adds no size or type check; the new code reads neither `/me` nor roles. Unknown is never 0: no card reads "0 KB", and an upload 200 without `case_revision` sends the last known revision, never 0 or blank. — verify: component test; `git diff -U0 frontend/src | grep -nE "PROOF_TYPES|PROOF_MAX_BYTES|accept=|useMe|/api/v1/me|roles"` returns nothing.

**Phone.** At 390 each drawer opens in F-05's bottom sheet with the same fields and order as desktop; nothing scrolls sideways; the "×", "Choose a file", Try again, Start and every segment and select are at least 44 by 44 px; Escape and Cancel close and return focus. — verify: e2e at 390 measuring bounding boxes.

**Fidelity (D-64, D-83).** One design-fidelity run per round over the 4 boards at 1440 and 390 on a production build. Coverage after approved exceptions is 100%; visual at least 90, or a board-level D-83 waiver with visual at least 70. Every exception has `role`, `name`, `category`, `reason`, `approved_by` and maps to a Conflicts number, and none covers a value the data can supply. — verify: the fidelity command; `round-<N>/fidelity/scores.txt`.

**Accessibility.** No axe violations (`wcag2a`, `wcag2aa`, `wcag21a`, `wcag21aa`, `wcag22aa`) at 1440 and 390 on both drawers in: empty, uploading, uploaded, failed, a 422 under a field (Proof, Months), and "Check again". The Proof group is labelled; the file input is named; errors and uploading are announced as text, not colour. — verify: `e2e/start-work-ppe-forecast.spec.ts`.

**Tokens and components only.** The diff adds no `#hex`, `rgb(`, `hsl(` or raw px outside tokens, and no local copy of `ProofField`, `useEvidenceUpload` or any `@/components` export. — verify: grep on the diff.

**Mock matches the contract, F-47 unchanged.** New lines and options validate against the generated E-LINES and E-LINE-OPTIONS schemas; every upload answer validates against the E-EVIDENCE-UPLOAD 200 schema; reset restores `C-FIN-PPE` 4 and `C-FIN-FORECAST` 2 and keeps `C-0101` 6, `C-FIN-SCHEDULES` 3, `C-FIN-LEDGER` 2; F-47's tests are green without a rewritten assertion; `git diff --stat` shows no change in `frontend/src/api/**`, `components/**`, `shell/**`, `features/response/**`, `mock/response.mjs`, `evidence.mjs`, `setup.mjs`, any existing fixture other than `lines.finance_lead.json` and `me.finance_lead.json`, `apps/**`, `architecture/**`, `design/**`, or the protected paths. — verify: `cd frontend && npx vitest run tests/start-work-ppe-forecast-mock.test.ts tests/start-work-proof-mock.test.ts tests/mock-contract.test.ts`; `git diff --stat`.

**Existing tests green; build.md evidence.** `delivery/checks.sh` passes and the Context tests pass. build.md lists commands and results, the 4 scores and waivers, every exception with its Conflicts number, every mock-only field and cookie (`start_hold` is new), the allowed edits outside the lane, the backend items and the held list. — verify: `delivery/checks.sh`; file content.

risk.rationale: Medium. It reuses F-47's merged upload and start path, and F-47 already got the high-risk review of the proof upload and the revision chain. The new part is two fixed-case lines on that path: the fixed-asset upload is append-only on a shared Finance case, so a stale revision would still hit another logger, and the forecast only starts a run. No money field, payroll or client sending is in this slice. SURFACES: ui, api, contract-change (the two lines and their fields, as the consumer of the proposed D-START-INTAKE). PRODUCT-ACCEPTANCE is required, because both drawers are new to the client.
